headline: Erasure新輯 克拉克退巡演
context: 英國電子流行二人組Erasure推出第20張專輯，主唱安迪．貝爾（Andy Bell）與范斯．克拉克（Vince Clarke）合作已滿40年。貝爾說，這段長年的友誼陪他們一起走過近年的艱難時刻，克拉克則宣布退出巡演。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Returning for a 20th album of sumptuous synthpop, Andy Bell and Clarke open up about difficult recent years, being happily uncool and battling resurgent homophobia Andy Bell is rabbiting away on multiple topics. There’s his farm in Mallorca, where he and his husband Stephen Moss have had a fine year harvesting pomegranates, kiwis and lemons. Then there’s the Erasure frontman’s fascination with clowns (“Would the makeup help you avoid facial recognition technology?”), memories of 90s nightclubbing (“You could do anything and get away with it!”) and a worry that he’s turning into “a fussy old grandpa”. Suddenly, he catches himself: “But what about you , Vince? You’re being very quiet!” Bell’s bandmate, whose only contribution since joining the video chat from his San Diego home has been to say hello, smiles. “No, no, I just love listening to you, man. I’m really enjoying this.” Continue reading...
sources.title: ‘It’s a deep soul connection’: Erasure on how 40 years of friendship got them through grief – and why Vince Clarke has quit touring

voice_text: Erasure出第20張專輯了，但范斯．克拉克要退出巡演。這個英國電子流行二人組的兩位成員，合作已經滿40年。主唱安迪．貝爾說，這段長年的友誼，陪他們一起走過近年的艱難時刻。
